verdict.rationale: Orb publishes an API reference and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec. However, a hands-on probe shows its reference pages set the Mintlify playground to "simple" display, which turns off the in-page runner, so no "Try it" control renders. Copyable code samples and a spec a user could load into an external tool are only workarounds, not an interactive reference with runnable examples, and nothing in the pack shows Orb providing one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
